name: Insertion Sort
code:
# Insertion Sort (RISC-V assembly)
# Sorts the array in place: a[0] .. a[n-1]
#
# a0 = base address of the array
# a1 = number of elements n
# t0 = i, t3 = j, t2 = key

    li a0, 0x0          # base address of the array
    li a1, 0xA          # n = 10 elements
    li t0, 0x1          # i = 1 (start at the second element)

outer:                        # for i = 1 .. n-1
    bge t0, a1, done
    slli t1, t0, 0x2         # t1 = i * 4
    add t1, a0, t1           # t1 = &a[i]
    lw  t2, 0x0(t1)          # key = a[i]
    addi t3, t0, -1          # j = i - 1

inner:                        # while j >= 0 and a[j] > key
    blt t3, zero, insert     # j < 0 -> insert the key
    slli t4, t3, 0x2         # t4 = j * 4
    add t4, a0, t4           # t4 = &a[j]
    lw  t5, 0x0(t4)          # t5 = a[j]
    bge t2, t5, insert       # key >= a[j] -> stop shifting
    sw  t5, 0x4(t4)          # a[j+1] = a[j] (shift right)
    addi t3, t3, -1          # j--
    j inner

insert:                       # a[j+1] = key
    addi t3, t3, 0x1         # j = j + 1
    slli t4, t3, 0x2
    add t4, a0, t4           # t4 = &a[j+1]
    sw  t2, 0x0(t4)          # a[j+1] = key
    addi t0, t0, 0x1         # i++
    j outer

done:                         # the array in memory is now sorted
